note: Description taken from Holmgren's 1910 account of Eutermes chaquimayensis (in German); the species was named by Holmgren in 1906 and the present work redescribes it, including the alate and soldier. Type locality Chaquimayo, Puno, Peru. The original is in German and the BHL scan OCR is only moderate: decimal points are often misread as commas or colons and some measurement digits are blurred; blurred values are not cited. The species was then placed in Eutermes and is now in Nasutitermes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate body length (with wings) 14 mm, without wings 8 mm, head width 1.50 mm; soldier body length 4—4.5 mm, head length 1.40—1.70 mm, head capsule chestnut-brown with a reddish brown nasus, frontal outline straight and the elevation at the base of the nasus distinct; the author stresses that the species is very close to E. peruanus, E. bolivianus and E. mojosensis and may only be a subspecies of one of them.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, the anterior part of the transverse band paler; postclypeus, genae, mandible bases, labrum and antennae rusty yellow; thoracic nota, pleura and legs rusty yellow; abdominal tergites pale brown, sternites paler with the middle rusty yellow; wings tinged yellow (greyish yellow). Head and body densely covered with bristles, only the occiput hairless. Head broadly oval; compound eyes medium-sized; ocelli rather large, the distance from the compound eyes less than their diameter; frontal marks very small, slit-like to long triangular; the muscle scars at the transverse band form an arc in front of the frontal marks. Base of the postclypeus very short, far shorter than half its width. Antennae 15-segmented: segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 2 but shorter than segment 3. Pronotum anterior margin straight with a small median notch, anterior corners sloping and rounded and blunt, lateral margins strongly narrowing posteriorly, posterior corners rounded and blunt, posterior margin more or less distinctly concave in the middle. Media close to the cubitus, with only one pair of branches at the end; cubitus with 10—12 branches, the inner 4—6 coarser. Measurements: body length (with wings) 14 mm, without wings 8 mm; head width 1.50 mm; from the anterior margin of the transverse band to the occiput 1.1 mm (the head length figure is blurred in the OCR and is not cited).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule (chestnut) brown, rusty reddish brown around the antennae, nasus tip reddish brown; antennae, legs and body sclerites rusty yellow to pale rusty brown; anterior margin of the pronotum and posterior margins of the meso- and metanota brown. Head with bristles at the base of the nasus and on the vertex; abdominal tergites almost completely smooth, with a marginal bristle row, the sternites additionally hairy. Head broadly oval; frontal outline straight, the elevation at the base of the nasus distinct; nasus conical, of normal length. Antennae 13-segmented: segment 3 distinctly longer than segment 2, segment 4 equal to segment 2. Pronotum short, the anterior lobe upturned at an angle, anterior margin not concave. Measurements: body length 4—4.5 mm; head length 1.4—1.7 mm.
